listening.title: Handing over work before a holiday

lines.speaker: Mai (HR Executive)
lines.text: Phong, I'm off from Monday to Friday next week. Can you cover for me?

lines.speaker: Phong (HR Officer)
lines.text: Of course. What do I need to know?

lines.speaker: Mai (HR Executive)
lines.text: I'm in charge of the new staff contracts. Two of them are still pending.

lines.speaker: Phong (HR Officer)
lines.text: Okay. When do they need to be signed?

lines.speaker: Mai (HR Executive)
lines.text: By Wednesday. I'll hand off the files to you this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Phong (HR Officer)
lines.text: Good. Should I contact the new staff directly?

lines.speaker: Mai (HR Executive)
lines.text: Yes. Their contact details are in the handover document on the team drive.

lines.speaker: Phong (HR Officer)
lines.text: And who should I talk to if there is a problem?

lines.speaker: Mai (HR Executive)
lines.text: Ask Ms. Hạnh. I've already informed her that you are my backup.

lines.speaker: Phong (HR Officer)
lines.text: Perfect. Enjoy your holiday, and I'll keep you in the loop by email.
